ex.s: By the time she was 13，her company was worth millions of dollars with the invention of a super-sweet treat that could save kids' teeth，instead of destroying them.

ex.s: A lady sitting in her rocking and shaking home, saw the wall part from the ceiling, open and shut twice, like a mouth, and then drop the end of a brick on the floor like a tooth.
ex.t: 一位女士坐在摇晃震动的家中，看见墙壁与天花板裂开，像一张嘴似的张开又合上两次，然后像掉牙齿一样，把一块砖的末端摔落在地上。

ex.s: Involve your child in the daily running of the house: tidying toys, feeding the dog, watering the plants. ____36____ When the tasks become as routine as brushing teeth, kids internalise that helping with housework is simply part of life.
ex.t: 让孩子参与家庭的日常运转：收拾玩具、喂狗、给植物浇水。____ 当这些任务变得像刷牙一样习以为常，孩子就会内化这样一种观念：帮忙做家务本来就是生活的一部分。
